shortDescription: Canada's main stock index was flat on Friday as investors weighed easing oil prices and small gains in precious metals against elevated bond yields.The S&P/TSX Composite Index TSX:TSX dipped 0.07% to 35,680.86 points by 09:32 a.m. ET.
